<!--

Keep Dubbo provider spans recording until asynchronous results complete, capturing the full duration and failures carried by either the future or response. Port only the Dubbo slice from #20675, stacked on #20721.

- **Compatibility:** Use `Result.whenCompleteWithContext` where available and `AsyncRpcResult.getResultFuture` on early 2.7 versions; preserve client and synchronous behavior.
- **Coverage:** Add direct completion/error tests and shared delayed-provider integration tests for library and javaagent instrumentation, retaining legacy, RPC preview, and duplicate telemetry assertions. Pin an additional javaagent suite to Dubbo 2.7.0.
metadata.title: End Dubbo provider spans on asynchronous completion
